provenance.note: All classification/board splits are new controlled engineering proposals. They do not change E1..E5, claim module pin order, or authorize production.

PWR_MAIN.purpose: Main eFuse, AON/UV, charge inhibit and converter interconnect passives; commercial converters stay separate.

PWR_BRANCH.purpose: E2 protected branches, current monitors and low-noise regulators. Candidate sub-board thermal split remains open.

CTRL_HMI.purpose: Bare MCP/HMI control, input protection, cooling drivers and local interface passives; purchased Pico/sensors remain modules.

USB_POWER.purpose: USB VBUS switches, HF+ LC damping, HDMI reverse isolation and LAB I2C buffer; intact high-speed cables retained.

RF_HMC.purpose: Three HMC7992 switches, their blocks, controls, pads/loads; final 50 ohm stackup not selected.

RF_HF.purpose: Two DPDT HF/VHF relays, drivers and individually terminated PARK paths.

RF_INJECTOR.purpose: Band-specific RF bias injectors, local RF bypass and three DC-tap/bleed front ends. May share RF substrate after qualification.

DC_CORE.purpose: 71-part low-frequency comparator/reference/sink core; RF taps and hot bleeds remain at RF ports, not on this core.

constraints.requirement: 4.6 A main path and 50 °C enclosure qualification; LAB5 <=3.2 A continuous, 4 A transient acceptance. Size copper/vias/connectors from chosen stackup and thermal calculation; no trace width is asserted here.
Keep raw E1_CELL0/B- distinct from GND/P-. No accidental copper, mounting-hole or balance-cable BMS bypass. J102 remains DNP/service-only.

LT3045 pair <=1 A physical total; Kelvin current-shunt routes, low-drop high-current planes, regulator exposed-pad heat flow and vendor capacitor placement are release work. LNB precision OVP and switch ratings need full temperature validation.

Keep each first24.9k RF tap plus100pF at its RF port; place12 bleeds at RF ports, away from core reference/precision dividers. Core boundary carries filtered DC TAP, not50ohm RF. Original schematic nodes preserved.

Clean low-leakage SENSE layout, short divider/input routes and local ground; do not place hot bleeds/regulators beside precision network. Leakage/TCR/RF/ground error must be measured:98.630mV analytical corner has only1.370mV margin to100mV.

Local100nF per comparator;1nF on each used internal reference; reference shunt/clamps/ground paths close. DCS HIGH=unsafe; LOW requires both window and both reference-good decisions. No signal pullup added on detector board; existing pullups belong E3.

Design envelope +/-30V limited DC. Verify chosen resistors rated voltage/power and PCB clearance for that envelope; no lightning/ESD compliance claim. Four249ohm bleeds dissipate0.226W each at30V and require >=0.5W parts with50C derating.

3V3_Q6A budget<=12mA includes E3 DCS pullups. At3.135V min supply, cold D450 VF must satisfy<=1.015V headroom for LM4040>=80uA. Each channel must reject+/-100mV over accepted temperature/supply and remain unsafe through startup/reference failure.

50ohm geometry requires approved dielectric/copper stackup and vendor footprint reference planes. Ground EPAD/grounds with short low-inductance returns and via fences; all15 HMC RF-terminal DC blocks remain. No generic width or finished impedance claimed.

HF selector10kHz..260MHz IL<=0.3dB, RL>=21dB, isolation>=35dB at162..260MHz plus STACK LF gates. The detector996ohm bleed alone adds0.2153dB ideal loss, making this a real acceptance risk. Relays use2/3 contacts for HF/VHF.
Power order GND->VDD->controls; shared3V3_Q6A,1k/100k/100pF controls,00 RF1 PARK. HMC isolation>=40dB at0.1..1.7GHz;37..40dB conditional only. X1 TX stays on internal load.

3.3V GPIO only; retain existing USB3/HDMI/PCIe cables/riser and their shield return. Do not create an unqualified high-speed PCB route from functional cable symbols. T7 WSON thermal condition TJ<=105C at1.5A requires copper/thermal validation.

Existing mechanical source calls for MCP expanders15..20mm from TPS7A4701, PTC and buck inductors, and I2C away from switching nodes. Separate CTRL/PWR domains are candidates; if combined, preserve this separation and recheck enclosure fit.

All partitions are engineering candidates. Final outline, mounting, stackup, copper weight, connector MPN/orientation and enclosure proof-fit are unset. No Gerbers/drill/production DRC is authorized by this preparation output.
